connector.name: MCP by getplexa.com
connector.registryDescription: Economic-safety tools for trading agents: executable quote + rug/honeypot pretrade check via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.getplexa. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AGENT_WALLET_KEY
env.description: Funded wallet private key — pays Plexa per call (x402 USDC) and signs locally. Plexa never receives it. Use a dedicated low-balance wallet.

env.name: PLEXA_BASE_URL
env.description: Plexa public API base URL (default https://api.getplexa.com).

env.name: CHAIN
env.description: Chain the wallet is funded on / quotes default to. Accepted: base | polygon | matic | arbitrum | arbitrum-one | arb | eip155:8453 | eip155:137 | eip155:42161 (default base). pretrade_check is Base-only today.
